dedupe_keys.name: empresa malaguena de transportes emt gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: Empresa Malagueña de Transportes (EMT): GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Empresa Malagueña de Transportes (EMT). Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Málaga, Andalusia, Spain, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Málaga, Andalusia, Spain. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 3 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Málaga, Andalusia, Spain). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Feed Information, Headsigns, Route Colors, Shapes. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the Mobility Database listing (licence field empty). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
